responsibility: Defines proc-macro helpers used by coverage unit tests to generate `BasicCoverageBlock` bindings concisely in test code.
same_name_distinction: This `lib.rs` is the root of the nested `coverage_test_macros` proc-macro crate, exporting the `let_bcb!` helper macro for coverage tests. Unlike the crate-root `compiler/rustc_mir/src/lib.rs`, it does not define `rustc_mir` modules or install any query providers.
